sources.title: UK local authority and regional greenhouse gas emissions statistics 2005 to 2024
facts: Provides UK local authority and regional greenhouse gas estimates through 2024.
Local authority estimates are aggregates and are not cadastral parcel observations.

sources.title: 2005 to 2024 UK local and regional greenhouse gas emissions statistical release web accessible
facts: Presents 2024 local and regional GHG estimates, trends, protected landscapes and reconciliation with the UK inventory.
Spatially allocated estimates must not be treated as direct parcel measurements.

sources.title: 2005 to 2024 UK local and regional greenhouse gas emissions technical report web accessible
facts: Documents spatial allocation methods for electricity, gas, industry, agriculture, transport, LULUCF and waste.
The report quantifies uncertainty and describes modelled or proxy distributions; these are not direct parcel observations.

sources.title: UK greenhouse gas emissions local authority and regional National Data Library
facts: Catalogue exposes the 2005 to 2024 local authority dataset and supporting LULUCF and technical resources.
Catalogue provenance does not itself establish parcel-level emissions.

sources.title: Local authority greenhouse gas emissions 2024 estimates announcement
facts: Announcement confirms the 2024 local authority and regional GHG release date.
Announcement metadata is not an emissions observation.

sources.title: Local authority greenhouse gas emissions 2025 estimates announcement
facts: Announcement indicates a provisional June 2027 release for 2025 estimates.
Future release metadata must not be treated as observed 2025 emissions.

sources.title: Electricity statistics collection
facts: Collection covers generation, fuel use, supply, consumption and capacity.
Electricity activity data require a valid emissions method before any GHG estimate and do not imply parcel binding.

sources.title: Energy Trends and Prices statistical release 30 June 2026
facts: Latest release page links provisional energy production, trade, generation, consumption and price statistics.
Energy activity and price data are not direct parcel greenhouse-gas observations.

sources.title: Energy Trends and Prices statistical release 30 June 2026 web report
facts: Reports February to April 2026 energy trends and electricity generation mix for Major Power Producers.
Generation share and fuel use are activity statistics, not direct parcel GHG measurements.

sources.title: Energy Trends UK electricity
facts: Publishes monthly and quarterly electricity generation, supply, consumption and fuel-use tables.
Electricity table values are not automatically parcel emissions.

sources.title: Clean Power 2030 metrics
facts: Metrics include clean generation share, clean demand share and estimated electricity emissions intensity.
Grid emissions intensity is not an absolute parcel emission without valid consumption, period and scope.

sources.title: Fuel mix disclosure data table 2024 to 2025
facts: Provides fuel mix disclosure parameters and transmission/distribution loss factor information.
Supplier disclosure and loss factors are not direct physical parcel emissions.

sources.title: DESNZ annual report 2025 to 2026 performance report
facts: Reports departmental performance and references territorial GHG and Clean Power metrics.
Corporate performance metrics and departmental waste totals are not parcel observations.

sources.title: Provisional UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics 2025
facts: Provides provisional 2025 UK territorial greenhouse-gas estimates by broad sector and fuel.
Provisional national estimates are subject to revision and are not parcel values.

sources.title: 2025 UK greenhouse gas emissions provisional figures statistical release
facts: Detailed provisional 2025 territorial GHG release includes sector, fuel, quarterly and international aviation/shipping sections.
Broad-sector provisional totals must not be promoted to parcel observations.

sources.title: Experimental statistics on carbon impact of local authority household waste announcement
facts: Announcement describes a future provisional annual release for carbon impacts of local-authority collected household waste.
Future announcement metadata is not observed waste carbon data.

sources.title: Voluntary MRV period for waste incineration
facts: Environment Agency guidance introduces a voluntary MRV-only period before UK ETS expansion to EfW and waste incineration.
Scheme participation guidance is not itself measured emissions.

sources.title: Voluntary MRV period for EfW and waste incineration detailed guidance
facts: Defines eligible activities and annual monitoring/reporting expectations during the voluntary period.
Monitoring plan, report and verification workflow must remain distinct from parcel binding and from unverified estimates.

sources.title: Science supporting cleaner waste incineration
facts: Explains scientific work distinguishing fossil and biogenic CO2 from waste incineration.
Method development or case-study evidence is not a direct parcel emissions dataset.

sources.title: Waste incinerator plant apply for R1 status
facts: Guidance covers R1 energy-efficiency status and updated submission requirements for waste incinerator plants.
R1 status and efficiency calculations are not direct greenhouse-gas emissions measurements.

sources.title: Medium combustion plant apply for an environmental permit
facts: MCP permits cover SO2, NOx and dust and set application, screening and monitoring requirements.
MCP permit status and air-pollutant limits are not greenhouse-gas measurements.

sources.title: Medium combustion plant screening tool
facts: SCAIL combustion screening models NOx and SO2 impacts for habitat screening.
Air-quality screening model outputs are not direct GHG observations.

sources.title: SR2018 number 7 low risk stationary medium combustion plant
facts: Standard rules were updated for hydrogen, gas-oil substitutes, stack arrangements and monitoring options.
Permit eligibility and ELVs are regulatory constraints, not measured GHG emissions.

sources.title: Changes to standard rules permits for medium combustion plant and specified generators
facts: Environment Agency consultation outcome changes standard rules availability and fuel provisions.
Regulatory decisions do not constitute observed emissions.

sources.title: Application for environmental permit low risk MCP and specified generator
facts: Application materials support low-risk MCP and specified-generator permitting.
Application fields and permit scope are not physical emissions observations.

sources.title: Application part C2.5 vary to add or change MCP or specified generator
facts: Application and combustion-plant list support permit variations and decarbonisation-readiness declarations.
Declared plant attributes and readiness are not measured GHG emissions.

sources.title: Mobile medium combustion plant boilers consultation
facts: Environment Agency consultation proposes a standard rules permit for mobile MCP boilers.
Consultation proposals and deployment conditions are not emissions observations.

sources.title: NAEI emissions from point sources
facts: NAEI point-source emissions combine regulator inventories, ETS data, operator data and modelled allocation methods.
Point-source location does not automatically establish a cadastral parcel measurement and some values are modelled.

sources.title: Oil and gas environmental alerts and incident reporting
facts: Guidance covers environmental incident and non-compliance reporting including combustion-plant-related cases.
Incident-reporting workflow is not a general emissions inventory or parcel GHG measurement.

sources.title: Humber Resources Group environmental permit application advertisement EPR PP3824MH A001
facts: Permit application includes risk assessment and modelling/monitoring of significant emissions to air, land or water.
An application and its proposed modelling do not prove observed greenhouse-gas emissions or parcel binding.

sources.title: Stuart Perkins environmental permit application advertisement EPR TP3536MZ V007
facts: Permit variation concerns a small waste incineration plant activity.
Permit variation status is not a measured greenhouse-gas emission value.
